title: Remove the Guard With Check
setup: Both queens stare at each other across the diagonal, and Black's queen on e5 is guarded only by the knight on c6.
hint: Trading queens gets nothing. Take away the queen's only guard, and do it with a tempo.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qxe5+}} at once only trades queens after {{Nxe5}}. The knight on c6 is the queen's only guard, so remove it first: {{Bxc6+}} takes the knight with check. Black must answer the check, with {{bxc6}}, a block on d7 or a king move, and none of them guards e5 again, so {{Qxe5+}} wins the queen for a bishop.

When a piece has one guard, capture the guard with check.
